# Artifact Gateway v0.2.0

## 简体中文

这是继 v0.1.0 之后的早期版本。主要变化：

- 新增 Maven、Raw 的 Hosted/Proxy/Group 目录浏览，以及 Maven Group 的多 Proxy 回退和 Raw Group 的逐成员回退。
- 新增制品生命周期下载统计和使用统计界面；仓库清理计划可显示下载证据，并可通过 `keepDownloadedDays` 保护近期下载的制品。
- 增加 Go Proxy 校验和数据库镜像、npm `whoami` 端点和 Go Proxy 上游凭据。
- 增加 Go Hosted 生命周期操作与隔离读取策略，以及 APT 签名快照的导出、校验和恢复能力。APT Hosted 仍属操作员预览。
- 改进 Console 的仓库浏览、主题、登录与小屏体验，并采用 MIT 许可证。

本版本提供 Linux/macOS amd64、arm64 Gateway 二进制归档、Console 静态包、OpenAPI 契约与 `SHA256SUMS`。二进制安装需要 PostgreSQL 和兼容 S3 的对象存储；解压前请校验 SHA256，部署时固定此版本和 Git Revision。

项目仍处于 1.0 之前，协议契约可能演进。详情见[变更记录](https://github.com/ccsert/artifact-gateway/blob/v0.2.0/CHANGELOG.zh-CN.md)和[协议兼容性说明](https://github.com/ccsert/artifact-gateway/blob/v0.2.0/docs/protocol-compatibility.zh-CN.md)。

## English

This early release follows v0.1.0. Highlights include:

- Hosted, Proxy, and Group directory browsing for Maven and Raw, with improved Group fallback.
- Durable artifact download usage, a Console usage view, and optional recent-download protection for retention.
- Go Proxy checksum database mirroring, npm `whoami`, and Go Proxy upstream credentials.
- Go Hosted lifecycle and quarantine-read controls, plus APT signed-snapshot export and recovery. APT Hosted remains an operator preview.
- Console usability improvements and MIT licensing.

The release includes Linux/macOS amd64 and arm64 Gateway archives, a static Console bundle, OpenAPI contracts, and `SHA256SUMS`. Binary installations require PostgreSQL and S3-compatible object storage. Verify the checksums and pin the version and Git revision. Pre-1.0 contracts may still evolve; see the [changelog](https://github.com/ccsert/artifact-gateway/blob/v0.2.0/CHANGELOG.md) and [protocol compatibility statement](https://github.com/ccsert/artifact-gateway/blob/v0.2.0/docs/protocol-compatibility.md).
